notes.title: Mission guidance added
notes.content:
Task guidance added

When you go home
You'll see a glowing object
Pick it up. It's your diary
It records the main mission you need to do
Of course, you can just look at it and not finish it ~!

Reduce the difficulty of some cave explorations
